tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night is the default theme; Paper is the print-and-daylight theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav bar, tags: anything that sits one step above the page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Featured cards and popovers: the one surface that should come forward.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed evidence: hero stage, AgentTrace, Terminal, card visuals.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, dot-grid pattern. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary Button), metric rules, hovered card borders. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk, signal-soft and current-soft (all ≥ 10:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy in long descriptions, ledes, metadata on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk (≥ 5.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, step durations, numbering. Small mono text on bg, surface and surface-sunk only (≥ 4.5:1); never for sentences.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Saffron — the brand's one loud colour. Primary Button fill, ContactBand ground, the agent core, model/result nodes. Once per view. Fill only: text in this hue uses signal-ink.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of signal fills. on-signal stays readable on it (≥ 7:1).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Saffron as text: italic accent words, index numbers, prompts. On bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and marks placed on signal or signal-strong (night 9.1:1, paper 5.6:1).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for signal Tags and the halo around live nodes. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Decorative planes only: cover blocks, illustration fills. Never behind text.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Electric teal — the connective colour: MCP and tool nodes, live edges, links between systems, focus. Pairs with saffron on the blue–orange axis, safe for red–green colour blindness.

tokens.name: current-ink
tokens.usage: Teal as text: MCP/tool step kinds, outcome labels, success lines in Terminal. On bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk (≥ 5.3:1).

tokens.name: on-current
tokens.usage: Text on a current fill (night 11:1, paper 4.95:1).

tokens.name: current-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for current Tags (status, availability). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed steps only, always with a word ('failed', 'error'). On bg and surfaces (≥ 5.2:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset. ≥ 3.9:1 on every surface in both themes. Inside ContactBand it switches to on-signal.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name only. One per page. The second word may be italic in signal-ink.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: ContactBand title and big metric values.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I architect agentic AI for the enterprise.
styles.usage: Hero statement and the first paragraph of a case study, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent checks permissions before it ever touches a table.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in UPPERCASE. Section indices, eyebrows, labels. The only place letterspacing opens up.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags and stack chips, sentence or proper case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to text inside a Tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight clusters: tag rows, step internals.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, label-to-value gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of compact panels; dot-grid pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters, section-header gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero column gap, ContactBand side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and ContactBand vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections. Generous air is the luxury signal; never compress it below space-8 on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, trace nodes, focus outlines on links — the 'precise' corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav monogram, card visuals, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, Terminal, AgentTrace, nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stages: Hero and ContactBand only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only. Pills are actions; nothing else is a pill.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly borders. Shadows appear on hover and on the primary action, never at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: ProjectCard on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary Button on hover — the saffron 'charge'.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page frame.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max width of case-study body copy (≈ 68ch at body).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: NavBar height; offset for sticky anchors.
